Menu Highlights

Known for these plates

Illustrative menu layout. The business will confirm current dishes and ordering options before launch.

Tacos

Best-of pick

Street-style tacos on corn tortillas with onion, cilantro and salsa — the dish that earned Los Altos its “best tacos in San Bernardino” mentions.

Menudo

Best-of pick

The traditional red-broth soup with hominy, served with onion, cilantro and lime — named among the best menudo in San Bernardino.

Tamales

Best-of pick

Hand-wrapped in corn husks and steamed — the tamales that landed Los Altos in “best tamales in San Bernardino” roundups.

Burritos

Big flour tortillas rolled tight around your choice of filling, rice and beans — a filling taqueria staple.

Enchiladas

Rolled tortillas covered in sauce and melted cheese, served as a classic Mexican combination plate.

Quesadillas

Tortillas grilled golden with melted cheese — simple, hot off the flat top, and hard to beat.
